faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Samagra Shiksha Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Samagra Shiksha Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 ANM (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Bachannapet), 1 Night Watch Woman (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Veldi), 1 Assistant Cook (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Ghanpur Station), 1 Night Watch Woman (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Zaffergadh).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Samagra Shiksha Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon, by by hand, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹7,800 for ANM (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Bachannapet), ₹8,710 for Night Watch Woman (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Veldi), ₹6,500 for Assistant Cook (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Ghanpur Station), ₹8,710 for Night Watch Woman (TGMS Girls' Hostel, Zaffergadh).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ANM: Intermediate pass with ANM training certificate from a government-recognised institution; Night Watch Woman and Assistant Cook: 7th class pass. Women candidates only. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are invited. First priority to local (habitation) candidates of the village where the hostel is located. Next, other eligible candidates of the mandal where the hostel is located will be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Test at IDOC, Jangaon on 15-11-2026 at 11.00 AM. A test will be held on 15-11-2026 at 11.00 AM at IDOC, Jangaon.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: TGMS Girls' Hostel, Bachannapet.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Copies of educational qualification certificates; Copies of local residence certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notification describes the engagement as: Temporary.
